name: polaris-api
description: API request client (sidecar): multi-tab, environment variables, cURL import/export, Params/Headers/Body editing; response views for table / object tree / path drill-down / field filtering. Requests are sent via a native Rust sidecar (reqwest) with no CORS / mixed-content / forbidden-header limits, equivalent to cURL.
releaseNotes:
Rebuild as a Rust sidecar HTTP client. v0.1.x was a universal frontend plugin positioned as an OpenAPI/Postman asset library — wrong direction, broken import modal (modalBg outside #root scope), mismatched styling, and cross-domain requests blocked by the sandbox CSP/CORS.

v0.2.0 ports the relay-devkit api module to a Rust sidecar architecture: backend uses reqwest to send requests natively (no CORS/mixed-content/forbidden-header limits, equivalent to cURL); ui is a full HTTP client with multi-tab, env vars, cURL import/export, Params/Headers/Body editors, and response table/object-tree/path-drilldown/field-filter views.

Verified: 44 smoke assertions, sidecar end-to-end (jsonplaceholder 200, httpbin POST with Cookie/Authorization forbidden headers preserved), browser integration (cancel button, cURL import, response views).
